A '''recorder''', also called '''audiorecorder''' and '''microrecorder''', was a device that could be used to capture sounds and replay them. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] used three recorders with [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]] growls on them to rescue [[Talon Karrde]] from the [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] crimelord [[Gamgalon]].
